snippet.title: How to God - Official Closed Beta Announce Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the How To God trailer for this upcoming god simulation VR game from developer Thoughtfish GmbH. Watch as you can be good or be evil as you control the lives of citizens, teach your creature to cause chaos, work wonders, shape your world, and more. How To God will be available on Meta Quest. A Closed Beta for How To God launches on July 21, 2025, and sign ups are now open.
